description: SPLICE Dataset: Integrated Electrification and Power System Planning with OnSSET and PyPSA-Earth - UGANDA Uganda case study is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Corrado Maria Caminiti. This repository contains the datasets used in SPLICE, a soft-linking framework for integrated energy and electrification planning. The framework couples OnSSET (geospatial electrification modelling) with PyPSA-Earth (power system optimisation) through an iterative cost-of-electricity feedback loop. This second update represent an minor adjustment of the datafolder structure to improve usability. Coverage: national (UG); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
